effective_search_query: methodology chapter conclusion abstract citation weighting

major_issues: 报告未能直接回答研究问题。研究问题是关于方法论章节与摘要结论的引用权重差异，但报告结论是'无法得出任何实质性结论'，这回避了问题核心。证据集中没有任何文献直接讨论或比较方法论章节与摘要结论的引用权重，报告应明确指出这一点，而非仅声明无法基于摘要得出结论。
报告第4节声称'无法直接比较权重'，但未基于证据说明原因。证据显示所有文献仅提供摘要级信息，没有任何一篇文献的摘要或元数据包含全文方法论章节的详细内容，因此证据本身就不支持进行权重比较的分析。报告应明确指出证据不足是根本限制，而非分析方法的限制。
citation_issues: 第1节引用[1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8]支持'遵循方法1试点流程'，但证据集中没有任何文献描述或定义'方法1试点流程'，这是无依据的引用。
第2节和第3节多次引用文献支持主题归纳，但部分归纳超出了证据范围。例如，文献[1]仅提及ABM是核心方法论之一，未声称其'有效'；文献[5]仅陈述AI是关键，未提及其'变革'作用。这些属于过度解读摘要。
第4节中，引用[1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8]支持'方法论细节缺失'和'结论上下文不明'的论断，但所有引用都是正确的，因为这些文献确实只提供了摘要级信息。然而，报告未明确指出这些引用仅用于说明证据的摘要性质，而非支持权重比较的论点。
revision_instructions: 明确回答研究问题：基于证据，直接指出没有文献讨论或比较方法论章节与摘要结论的引用权重，因此无法从证据中得出答案。修订结论部分，避免模糊表述。
修正无依据的引用：移除或重述关于'方法1试点流程'的引用，确保所有方法论描述严格基于证据内容。
精确归纳证据：确保所有对文献主题、方法论和结论的归纳严格限定在证据提供的摘要信息范围内，避免添加解释性形容词或推断。
强化证据局限性分析：明确指出证据集本身（均为摘要）就不包含全文方法论章节的详细信息，因此根本不可能进行权重比较，而不仅是'无法直接比较'。

top_papers.title: Development of models and methods for creating a digital twin of plant within the cyber-physical system for precision farming management
top_papers.abstract: Abstract The paper discusses creation of a digital twin (DT) of plant for an intelligent cyber-physical system for managing precision farming. A new approach to formalization of DT knowledge is proposed to form expert knowledge within the subject area based on the ontological specification of stages of plant growth and development and multi-agent technology for creating stage agents and coordinated dynamic recalculation of stage duration and yield forecast based on events in the environment. The paper proposes a method for calculating the forecast for duration of plant development stages and yield based on expert knowledge. top_papers.title: Anthropomorphism of Artificial Intelligence Service Agent and Consumer Responses: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Agenda
top_papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Artificial intelligence service agent (AISA) anthropomorphism is increasingly applied in service situations to deliver consumers a more personalized service experience. Extensive research has explored it over the past decade. However, the body of knowledge about this domain remains fragmented due to the lack of a comprehensive review. This paper aims to understand the domain through a framework‐based systematic literature review approach. We conducted an in‐depth analysis of 149 peer‐reviewed articles retrieved on April 25, 2024. top_papers.title: Personal touch in digital customer service: a conceptual framework of relational personalization for conversational AI
top_papers.journal: Journal of Service Theory and Practice
top_papers.abstract: Purpose Customer service conversations are becoming increasingly digital and automated, leaving service encounters impersonal. The purpose of this paper is to identify how customer service agents and conversational artificial intelligence (AI) applications can provide a personal touch and improve the customer experience in customer service. The authors offer a conceptual framework delineating how text-based customer service communication should be designed to increase relational personalization. Design/methodology/approach This paper presents a systematic literature review on conversation styles of conversational AI and integrates the extant research to inform the development of the proposed conceptual framework.
